title: BycatchEstimatorStan User Guide
text: Run example data BycatchEstimator Look output html file see whether problems data setup. Now run BycatchStan bycatchStanSim function prints output rds file, can read back later make plots look diagnostics. following code takes either output just read outputs section looks diagnostics. Plot annual bycatch estimates model selection table Pick AIC best model Read corresponding Stan model object (deleted environment save space) Plot residuals Plot prior posterior densities parameters Plot prior posterior draws bycatch Convergence diagnostics Parameter summary table
code: obsdat<-droplevels(LLSIM_BUM_Example_observer[LLSIM_BUM_Example_observer$Year>2014 &LLSIM_BUM_Example_observer$fleet==2,]) logdat<-droplevels(LLSIM_BUM_Example_logbook[LLSIM_BUM_Example_logbook$Year>2014 & LLSIM_BUM_Example_logbook$fleet==2,]) setupObjBUM<-bycatchSetup(   obsdat = obsdat,   logdat = logdat,   yearVar = "Year",   obsEffort = "sets",   logEffort = "sets",   factorVariables = c("Year","area"),     numericVariables = NA,    EstimateBycatch = TRUE,   logNum = NA,   sampleUnit = "trips",   baseDir = getwd(),   runName = "LLSIMBUMtripExample",   runDescription = "LLSIm BUM by trip, with 5% observer coverage",   common = "Blue marlin",   sp = "Makaira nigricans",   obsCatch ="BUM",   catchUnit = "number",   catchType = "catch",   reportType = "html"   ) modelsToRun<-c("y~Year","y~1") useCode="cmdstanr" BUMRun<-bycatchStanSim(setupObjBUM,                         modelsToRun=modelsToRun,                         spNum=1,  #which species to run in input is multispecies                         modeledEffort=FALSE,                         priors =  list(interceptSD=10,                                       coefficientSD=1,                                       phiType=c("exponential","normal")[1],                                       phiPar=1),                         StanOutDir=NULL,  #Null to use base directory from SetupObj                         useCode=useCode) #Specify directory with bycatch Estimator results outDir<-setupObjBUM$bycatchInputs$outDir # Date of bycatch estimator run estimatorDate<-Sys.Date() # Date of stan run stanDate<-Sys.Date() # Read in bycatchEstimator setup setupObj<-readRDS(paste0(outDir,"/",estimatorDate,"_BycatchSetupSpecification.rds")) spNum<-1 #Stan output directory StanOutDir<-paste0(outDir,"/","Bluemarlincatch") # Read in stan run summary files stanSum<-readRDS(paste0(StanOutDir,                          "/STAN",stanDate,"StanOutputs.rds")) #Choose outputs to use stanSum<-BUMRun setupObj<-setupObjBUM plotStan(stanSum$yearSum) stanSum$waictab modelNum<-which(stanSum$waictab$Dwaic==0) #To get WAIC best stanObj<-readRDS(BUMRun$stanRunFiles[[modelNum]]) getResiduals(stanSum,               stanObj,              modelNum,              setupObj,              useCode=useCode) plotPriorPosterior(stanSum,                     stanObj,                    useCode=useCode) plotPriorPosteriorSims(stanSum=stanSum,                        modelNum=modelNum,                        stanObj=stanObj,                        setupObj=setupObj,                        modeledEffort = FALSE,                        effortSD = NULL,                        useCode=useCode) getConvergence(stanObj,                useCode=useCode) getSummary(stanSum,            stanObj,            modelNum,            setupObj,            spNum=1,            useCode=useCode)

title: BycatchEstimatorStan User Guide
text: Code run survival/mortality model. simulated survival data (arbitrary values). numerical variables, need standardized using mean sd observer data consistency. data year category, standardization needed. Run multiple models get best one. Doesn’t calculate predicted probability survival (predictP=FALSE) outputs include model selection diagnostics tables. function give posterior predictive checks probability model. predictions year BUM, best model
code: mortData<-read.csv("data/SimulatedMortality.csv") modelsToRun=c("y~1","y~Species","y~Year","y~Year+Species") MortResults<-mortalityStan(mortData=mortData,                           predData = NULL,                           modelsToRun=modelsToRun,                           factorVariables=c("Species","Year"),                           numericVariables=NA,                           mortalityColumn="dead",                           outDir=getwd(),                           runName="Simulated",                           predictP=FALSE,                           useCode=useCode   ) MortResults$waictab MortResults$diagTable mortModelNum<-which(MortResults$waictab$Dwaic==0) plotPPCMortality(y=mortData$dead,                        modelNum=1,                        mortalityStanList=MortResults$stanRuns,                        useCode=useCode) predData<-obsdat %>%   distinct(Year)%>%   mutate(Species="BUM") predData MortResultsP<-mortalityStan(mortData=mortData,                            predData = predData,                            modelsToRun=modelsToRun[mortModelNum],                            factorVariables=c("Species","Year"),                            numericVariables=NA,                            mortalityColumn="dead",                            outDir=getwd(),                            runName="Simulated",                            predictP=TRUE,                              useCode=useCode   )

title: BycatchEstimatorStan User Guide
text: Combine mortality bycatch estimate get bycatch mortality survival Estimates total bycatch mortality
code: mortalityEsts<-getMortPred(stanSum=stanSum,                            modelNum=which(stanSum$waictab$Dwaic==0),                            stanObj=stanObj,                            Species="BUM",                            setupObj=setupObj,                            modeledEffort = FALSE,                            effortSD = NULL,                            useCode=useCode,                            mortResults=MortResultsP,                           mortModelNum=1)  plotMortalityFunc(mortalityEsts,Species="BUM") head(mortalityEsts)
